name: argument-parser-negative-test-706c373f17/invalid-float-03-p.bal
reason: The float parameter declaration is supported, but the expected failure depends on command-line argument conversion and rejection of an invalid hexadecimal float string, which subset10 does not cover.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line argument parsing and conversion to a main function float parameter
test_design_notes: The invalid float is supplied only by the @args comment, not as an illegal Ballerina numeric literal.
The @panic marker expects startup argument rejection despite an empty function body; marker syntax itself is not an unsupported language construct.
